data_policy: Mutating checks ran in isolated Compose projects with synthetic data. The real local install was changed only by replacing web and worker together while no jobs were active, then running one public normal sync from the settings screen.

changes.worker_version: web and worker replaced together with one image; app/*.py and *.sql (70 files) identical in both containers and the workspace
changes.file_list_current: FileView.current (required boolean). Newest original per page plus its linked preview, and the newest ugoira bundle's zip/timing/preview/video are current; a damaged newest file stays current
changes.damaged_archive_status: a kept original (ugoira zip/timing) left corrupt/missing/unreadable with no ready file gives partial instead of pending; first downloads and staged writes stay pending

changes.validate_absorb: a new request (new Idempotency-Key) for an account job held in waiting_auth resumes it; same-key replay returns it unchanged; validate jobs join the automatic resume after a verified login
